LanguageData.RavenReliquaryStand.label: [Raven] Reliquary Stand
LanguageData.RavenReliquaryStand.description: A reliquary stand themed around the Raven totem. The obsidian base is carved with a crest of a Raven spreading its wings, and a mysterious reliquary rack floats at the top. It is said that relics enshrined here will be blessed by the Raven deities.
